name: zfmv_script_reset
description: zFMV_Script::Reset either rewinds the current action or destroys the action list and clears list state.
known_limits: VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 COFF byte compare passes with zero unmasked mismatches and no relocation-masked bytes after trimming 9 trailing VC NOPs; Binary Ninja body is 71 bytes and the VC object body is 80 bytes.

The source keeps the raw zFMV_Action_Vtbl table owner but uses a narrow zFMV_ActionScalarDeletingDestructorDispatch overlay at Reset's slot-0 callsite so VC5 emits action in ecx and only the scalar-delete flag on the stack.
The native smoke covers Reset(0) preserving the list and setting current=head, plus Reset(1) deleting every action with flags=1 and clearing head/tail/current.
